messages:
Alex K: ok who thought YAML would be a good place to hide a single missing space? 
Alex K: pushed a tiny config tweak, prod started rejecting model loads. error was 
Alex K: ```
Error: unexpected key at line 42, column 3
  at parse (/app/config/parser.go:87)
```
Maria P: legendary. did you use tabs? :older_woman::joy:
Alex K: no tabs. 2 spaces everywhere. but the `routes:` block lost one space in a copy/paste. classic off-by-one.
Kevin L: the compiler is basically a romantic poet: it only breaks when you least expect feelings. :broken_heart:
Jules: in my next life i'm becoming a YAML linter. i'll haunt people with `trailing-space: true` warnings. :ghost:
deploy-bot: [SYSTEM] Rollback triggered for service/redwood-inference-api due to healthcheck failures (5xx).
Maria P: pro tip: i have a tiny pre-commit that checks indentation + `yq` sanity check. saved me more times than coffee.
Alex K: sharing the diff that broke it:
Alex K: ```diff
- routes:
-  - /health: 
+ routes:
+ - /health: 
```
Alex K: one extra space and suddenly the route is an item under `routes` instead of a mapping. sigh.
Kevin L: semver joke: this is a patch fix, but the emotional impact is major. bump to 0.2.1-heartbreak? :joy:
Jules: can we please add a linter to CI that yells at us before deployment? :pray:
Maria P: i'll add a quick GH action. `uses: docker://mikefarah/yq` + `yq eval` check. makes life nicer.
Alex K: thanks. and also if anyone wants to leave a revenge emoji on the commit, please do. :rage: :joy:
Kevin L: attached a meme: "compiler says it's fine, runtime says LOL" (imagine)
Alex K: fixed on prod, service healthy. moral of the story: YAML is ferociously opinionated and petty.
Jules: new office motto: "Indent like your uptime depends on it."
Maria P: pinned.
Kevin L: also if we ever open-source our configs, we must include a `YAML Apology` section in the README.
Alex K: done. added to docs: `We apologize for any accidental oxford commas and misindented routes.`
